Credential-free 1280×720 screenshots from the pinned Linux client, used to
check that installation controls match real overlays, including rejection of
the empty URL dialog and the no-addons screen. `hosted-manifest.png` and
`hosted-long-url-manifest.png` show the hosted add-on dialog with the add-on
URL blacked out; a credential-length URL wraps and moves Install down. These
are UI-state evidence, not playback proof.
